min_mapq.title: Minimum mapping quality
min_mapq.description: Fragments from reads below this MAPQ are ignored.

min_length.title: Minimum fragment length
min_length.description: Shortest fragment kept in the histogram.

max_length.title: Maximum fragment length
max_length.description: Longest fragment kept in the histogram.

exclude_duplicates.title: Exclude duplicate reads
exclude_duplicates.description: Skip records carrying the duplicate flag (0x400).

max_records.title: Maximum records
max_records.description: Stop after this many fragments (0 = no limit).

output.title: Output name
output.description: Context key that receives the histogram.
